faqs.a1: No. Setup and onboarding are included in every plan. Our team imports your menu, pairs your hardware, and trains your staff in a guided session — typically live within the hour.

cafe.title: A café counter never quite closes.
cafe.standfirst: Between the morning rush, modifier after modifier, and the customer who hesitates at payment — a café counter has to stay fluid without ever making people wait.

workflow.pain: The morning rush piles up at the counter
workflow.solutionTitle: A two-click modifier flow
workflow.solutionBody: Caisse Manager groups frequent options on a single order screen: two clicks are enough to specify size, milk, and syrup — no screen switching. Order-taking time drops mechanically, even at peak hours.

workflow.pain: No way to tell which branch is busiest
workflow.solutionTitle: Live per-branch sales dashboard
workflow.solutionBody: Each branch streams its sales in real time to a central dashboard. The manager sees at a glance which store is overloaded and which is quiet — and adjusts staffing, without waiting for tonight's close.

workflow.pain: A customer interrupting a purchase blocks the whole line
workflow.solutionTitle: The order stays open; a new tab starts for the next customer
workflow.solutionBody: Rather than blocking the register, the in-progress order stays open on its own tab while a new tab opens for the next person. The counter keeps moving, and you come back to the paused order the moment it's ready to close.

workflow.pain: The cash drawer opens by hand — that slows checkout
workflow.solutionTitle: The drawer opens automatically the moment payment is accepted
workflow.solutionBody: The instant the payment is confirmed in Caisse Manager, the cash drawer pops open. The cashier gives change and moves to the next customer without an extra step.

ecosystem.body: A pastry café that's always packed at peak. Room 21 keeps a customer's order open while a new tab starts for the next, and the cash drawer opens automatically at every checkout — two details that, added up across a full day, change how smoothly the service feels.

goDeeper.title: Self-order kiosk
goDeeper.body: At peak hours, a self-order kiosk absorbs part of the order flow without adding counter staff — useful as soon as the morning line grows past what a single register can handle.

client.storyTitle: A room that fills up and never fully empties.

client.pressure: A single open order is the enemy. The counter needs a second, third and fourth ticket running at once — and the drawer opening on its own each time money changes hands.

fast-food.title: In fast food, every second of waiting is a lost sale.
fast-food.standfirst: The fast-food promise is speed — and that promise plays out in the kitchen and in delivery as much as at the counter. A ticket that doesn't reach the right station, a delivery order lost between two screens: every friction shows up directly in service time.

workflow.pain: Every second of line time costs a sale
workflow.solutionTitle: Kitchen display synced live with the register
workflow.solutionBody: Every order confirmed at the register appears instantly on the kitchen display, in the optimal prep order. There's no lag between checkout and firing.

workflow.pain: Delivery orders arrive from everywhere at once
workflow.solutionTitle: A single screen for Glovo, Yassir, and Done
workflow.solutionBody: Glovo, Yassir, and Done orders land in the same flow as internal orders, on the same screen. No more toggling between delivery tablets and the register — everything converges in one place.

workflow.pain: Counter and kitchen work off two different tickets
workflow.solutionTitle: Orders are routed straight to the right station
workflow.solutionBody: Every order is automatically sent to the relevant prep station, without re-entry or manual printing. Counter and kitchen work off the same source of truth, in real time.

workflow.pain: An interrupted order blocks the counter line
workflow.solutionTitle: The order stays on hold; a new tab opens for the next customer
workflow.solutionBody: The in-progress order goes on hold in its own tab, and the counter can immediately start a new order for the next customer — without losing the first.

workflow.pain: The cash drawer opens by hand at every checkout
workflow.solutionTitle: The drawer opens automatically after payment is accepted
workflow.solutionBody: The moment payment is confirmed, the drawer pops open on its own. One gesture removed from every transaction, across hundreds of transactions a day.

dine-in.title: A restaurant is run table by table, not ticket by ticket.
dine-in.standfirst: Table service has its own rules: track each table's state, send courses to the kitchen in the right order, handle checks that rarely split evenly. A system built for counter-speed retail doesn't cut it — you have to think dining-room, not just checkout.

workflow.pain: Splitting a check slows the next table
workflow.solutionTitle: One-gesture check splitting, whichever way it goes
workflow.solutionBody: Split the check in one gesture — per person, per dish, or evenly, depending on what the guests want. Payment happens without a manual recalculation.

workflow.pain: Courses arrive out of sync with the kitchen
workflow.solutionTitle: Course-by-course tickets on their own timer
workflow.solutionBody: Each course fires its own kitchen ticket at the right service moment. The kitchen preps in the order the dining room expects, not in the order tickets land.

workflow.pain: Table state is a guess from across the room
workflow.solutionTitle: Live floor plan, table by table
workflow.solutionBody: A floor plan shows every table's state in real time — ordering, waiting for a course, ready for the check, free. Staff know where to step in without walking the whole room.

workflow.pain: An interruption halts a table mid-service
workflow.solutionTitle: The check stays open; a new table starts on another tab
workflow.solutionBody: That table's check stays open on its own tab without blocking the rest of the service. Staff keep serving the other tables normally.

workflow.pain: The cash drawer opens by hand at every payment
workflow.solutionTitle: The drawer opens automatically after payment is accepted
workflow.solutionBody: The moment payment is confirmed, the drawer opens on its own — no extra step for the floor staff.

bakery.title: A bakery's day starts before everyone else's.
bakery.standfirst: A bakery doesn't run like a regular shop — the oven's lit before dawn, products have a short shelf life, and event orders are booked months ahead. Its POS has to know these constraints.
bakery.intro: The oven is lit before dawn, the first customers arrive before the neighbourhood's internet is even stable, and every loaf has a limited lifespan.

workflow.pain: The register has to work before the internet even wakes up
workflow.solutionTitle: Offline-ready POS for pre-dawn openings
workflow.solutionBody: The register keeps ringing normally without a connection, and syncs automatically the moment the network returns. The morning opening never waits on the internet.

workflow.pain: Bread goes stale — nobody tracks the loss
workflow.solutionTitle: Waste and expiry alerts on every batch, via the Odoo integration
workflow.solutionBody: Each production batch is tracked with its expiry. The Odoo integration triggers an alert before a product becomes unsellable, so you can adjust prices or tomorrow's production with full awareness.

workflow.pain: Wedding and event orders get lost in a paper notebook
workflow.solutionTitle: Pre-orders and deposits managed via the Odoo integration
workflow.solutionBody: Event orders are recorded with deposit, pickup date, and order details directly in the system, via the Odoo integration — visible to the whole team, not just the person who took the call.

workflow.pain: Selling by weight invites pricing mistakes
workflow.solutionTitle: Native scale integration, price calculated automatically
workflow.solutionBody: The scale is wired straight into the register: product weight is read automatically and the price computed without manual entry, from the first gram to the last.

faqs.setup1A: Most operations are live within an hour of receiving the hardware. Menu import, staff accounts, and printer pairing happen on a guided onboarding call.
faqs.setup2Q: Can I import my menu from another POS?
faqs.setup2A: Yes. Send us a CSV (or a screenshot of your current menu screens) and we'll import categories, items, modifiers, and prices for you before Day One.
faqs.hardware1Q: Do I have to buy hardware from you?
faqs.hardware1A: No. Caisse Manager runs on the hardware we sell and on most Android-based POS terminals. If you already have terminals, we'll check compatibility before you commit.
faqs.hardware2Q: Which printers work with Caisse Manager?
faqs.hardware2A: Any ESC/POS-compatible thermal printer over Ethernet, USB, or Bluetooth. We ship a tested list with onboarding — most Epson, Star, and Xprinter models are plug-and-play.
faqs.payments1A: Caisse Manager integrates with CMI and TPE Mobile for in-store card payments. Settlement happens through your bank — we don't hold funds.
faqs.payments2A: Close Day produces a Z report comparing cash counted to expected, with per-tender breakdowns. Discrepancies surface immediately so they get resolved while the shift is still standing there.
faqs.integrations1Q: Do you integrate with Glovo and Yassir?
faqs.integrations1A: Yes. Direct API integrations route incoming delivery orders straight to your kitchen as if they were dine-in tickets, with the platform's commission and delivery fees handled in your daily reports.
faqs.integrations2Q: Can I export data to my accountant?
faqs.integrations2A: End-of-day exports are downloadable as CSV or Excel. Many of our customers wire them straight into their accounting tool via a Make.com or Zapier flow we'll help you set up.
faqs.backoffice1Q: Can I run multiple locations on one account?
faqs.backoffice1A: Yes. The Backoffice supports unlimited locations with per-location menus, staff, and reports — rolled up into a single multi-store view for owners.
faqs.backoffice2A: Roles: Cashier, Manager, Waiter, Owner. Each role has configurable permissions (discounts, voids, reports, etc). Sensitive actions like discounts can require manager approval at the POS.
faqs.mobile1Q: Is there a customer-facing ordering app?
faqs.mobile1A: Yes. A branded online ordering app comes standard. Your menu, your colors, your domain — your customers order without ever leaving your brand.
faqs.mobile2Q: Does the delivery app work offline?
faqs.mobile2A: Drivers can complete deliveries with intermittent signal — orders sync the moment connectivity returns. Critical operations (mark delivered, take photo proof) all work offline-first.

privacy.effectiveDate: Effective 17 July 2026 — supersedes any earlier version.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Caisse Manager SARL ("Caisse Manager", "we") collects, uses, and protects the information you send us — whether you're a merchant using our POS software, a visitor to our site, or an end customer of a business equipped with Caisse Manager. By using our site, our POS software, or our mobile app, you accept the practices described here.

sections.heading: 1. What information we collect
paragraphs: Depending on your relationship with Caisse Manager, we may collect:
bullets: Identity information — name, role, company name, email, and phone number when you create an account, request a demo, or apply to our partner program.
Transaction data — receipts, amounts, payment methods, and items sold, generated by daily use of the POS software.
Loyalty data (optional) — name and contact details of an end customer, only if they provide these voluntarily as part of a loyalty program you enable.
Technical data — IP address, device and browser type, connection logs, necessary for platform operation and security.
Site navigation data — pages viewed, visit duration, for audience-measurement purposes.

sections.heading: 2. What we do with this information
paragraphs: We use the collected information to:
bullets: Provide, maintain, and secure the POS service and associated features (sales reports, inventory, loyalty).
Provide technical support and reply to your requests.
Process billing for your subscription.
Improve our products using aggregated and anonymised usage statistics.
Inform you of important software or policy updates.
Send you, if you consent, information about our news, offers, or events.

sections.heading: 3. Mobile app and mobile POS
paragraphs: The mobile POS and the web ordering app access only the data strictly necessary for checkout: sales, receipts, and the connected device identifier. They never access the contacts, photos, or continuous location of the device they're installed on, and are not used for advertising.

sections.heading: 4. Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable physical, electronic, and organisational measures to protect the information we collect against unauthorised access, loss, or disclosure. Communications between your register and our servers are encrypted. Card payments are processed by our certified banking partner (CMI); Caisse Manager never stores a full card number.
As no system is infallible, we can't guarantee absolute security, but we commit to informing you without undue delay in case of an incident affecting your data.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: Our site uses cookies: small files placed on your device that let us recognise your browser and improve your experience.
bullets: Necessary cookies — connection to your account, language preferences. The site doesn't function correctly without them.
Audience-measurement cookies — used only for statistical purposes to understand which pages are useful, then aggregated.

sections.heading: 6. Sharing with third parties and external links
paragraphs: We share information only with providers strictly necessary for the service (payment processing via CMI, hosting, delivery integrations you activate yourself like Glovo, Yassir, or Done). Each of these providers is contractually required to protect the data they process on our behalf.

Our site may contain links to third-party sites. Once you leave our site via one of these links, we no longer have control over that site and can't be held responsible for the protection of information you provide there. We invite you to review the privacy policy of any third-party site you visit.

sections.heading: 7. Retention period
paragraphs: We retain your information for the duration of the contractual relationship, then archive it for the period required by accounting and tax obligations applicable in Morocco, before deletion or anonymisation.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights and how to exercise them
paragraphs: In accordance with law 09-08 on the protection of individuals regarding the processing of personal data, you have rights of access, rectification, deletion, and objection concerning data about you.
bullets: To request a copy of the information we hold about you, write to us at contact@caissemanager.com.
If you believe information we hold is incorrect or incomplete, tell us and we'll correct it promptly.
If you no longer want to receive marketing communications, an unsubscribe link appears in every email, or you can write to us directly.

If you're the end customer of a business using Caisse Manager and want your loyalty data deleted, first contact that business, which remains responsible for your data; we support them technically in this process.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may modify this policy from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or practice changes. The update date at the top of this page is refreshed with each change. We encourage you to review it periodically.

sections.heading: 10. Contact us
paragraphs: For any question about this privacy policy, contact us at contact@caissemanager.com. We reply to every request within 30 days.

industryOverview.metaDescription: Cafés, bakeries, fast food, restaurants, beauty, barbers, retail — Caisse Manager, the connected ecosystem built from real counter problems.
industryOverview.title: Every counter has its blocker. We've already solved it.
industryOverview.body: Caisse Manager is a connected ecosystem — POS, kitchen, inventory, reservations — built from real field problems: cafés, bakeries, fast food, restaurants, beauty salons, barbershops, and retail. Reservations, pre-orders, and appointments run on our Odoo integration.
industryOverview.proofTitle: Battle-tested at the counter, not just on paper.
industryOverview.proofBody: A few establishments already running their ecosystem on Caisse Manager.

proof.name: Texas Chicken
proof.body: A multi-site franchise has to keep the same menu everywhere. Kitchen tickets sync live with the register, delivery orders land on a single screen, and prices stay identical across locations.

proof.name: Crusty
proof.body: A multi-site chicken-and-rice chain where every second in line counts. Crusty keeps the kitchen display synced live with the counter and centralises delivery orders on a single screen.

proof.name: Panda Sushi
proof.body: Table turnover comes down to timing. Panda Sushi uses a live floor plan, kitchen tickets sent course by course, and one-gesture check splitting — without holding up the next table.

proof.name: L'Artisan
proof.body: Butchery, poultry, and fine grocery on one side; a wood-fire restaurant on the other, under the same roof. L'Artisan rings a grocery item and orders from the restaurant on the same ticket, at the same time, without juggling two registers.

proof.name: Primos
proof.body: A fast-food chicken chain where speed makes the difference. Primos syncs kitchen and counter live and consolidates delivery orders on a single screen.

proof.name: Panini Grill
proof.body: Between paninis, tacos, and grilled items, every order has to come out fast. Panini Grill routes tickets straight to the right kitchen station and keeps the register fluid during rushes with multi-tab orders.

proof.name: Room 21
proof.body: A pastry café that's always packed at peak. Room 21 keeps a customer's order open while a new tab starts for the next, and the cash drawer opens automatically at every checkout.

proof.name: 75 Flavours
proof.body: A café-restaurant serving from breakfast through late dinner. 75 Flavours keeps a live floor plan and splits checks in one gesture, without slowing the next table.

proof.name: Thé-Mara
proof.body: A pastry café where every product has to be tracked both in-shop and in the tea room. Thé-Mara manages product records, expiry alerts, and inventory straight from the register, without juggling multiple tools.

proof.name: Maison Adena
proof.body: A bakery-café where pastries and service have to keep the same rhythm at peak hours. Maison Adena keeps the register ready even offline and receives an alert before stock rolls over.

proof.name: Ikbal Gourmandise
proof.body: A pastry-gourmandise where every batch has its own expiry to watch. Ikbal Gourmandise gets per-batch waste and expiry alerts, and sells by weight with zero pricing error.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Caisse Manager, the Moroccan POS ecosystem born in Agadir, deployed across 5 cities, used by 500+ brands. Making the register calmer, one screen at a time.
aboutPage.title: Making the register calmer.
aboutPage.body: Restaurants run on rhythm. Every interruption — a clumsy modifier modal, a screen fighting the cashier's hands, a kitchen ticket printing late — breaks that rhythm. We're obsessed with removing those interruptions, one screen at a time.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From Agadir to all of Morocco.
aboutPage.storyBody: Since the first deployment in Agadir, the company has grown to cover Morocco's main cities — Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakech, Tangier — with local field teams able to install and train the same day. Today, 500+ brands trust Caisse Manager to run their registers, from fast food to retail, from independent cafés to international chains.

events.name: Marocotel 2024
events.location: Mohammed VI Exhibition Park · El Jadida
events.body: Caisse Manager was present at the 18th edition of Marocotel, the International Trade Show for Professional Equipment for Hospitality, Restaurants, Food Trades, Wellness, and Leisure. A reference event on the African continent that gathered more than 21,800 professional visitors and 250 national and international exhibitors — the occasion for our teams to present our register ecosystem to decision-makers in Moroccan hospitality and restaurants.

events.name: Cremaï 2025
events.body: Caisse Manager was present at Cremaï 2025 in Marrakech, the reference meeting point for restaurant and agri-food professionals in Morocco. The occasion to present our register ecosystem to restaurateurs, chains, and future partners. Our teams showed our terminals and interface to visitors, and spoke with them directly on site.

events.name: Marocotel 2026
events.location: Mohammed VI Exhibition Park · El Jadida
events.body: Caisse Manager was present at the 19th edition of Marocotel, held under the aegis of the Ministry of Tourism. A must-attend event for hospitality and restaurant decision-makers in Morocco and across the African continent, bringing together hundreds of exhibitors and tens of thousands of professional visitors. Our teams presented our register ecosystem to hoteliers and restaurateurs on site, with live demonstrations of our terminals and interface.

events.name: Franchise Exhibition Morocco 2026
events.body: Caisse Manager was present at the Franchise Exhibition Morocco 2026, organised by the Moroccan Franchise Federation (FMF). After a well-received first edition in 2025, this major sector event brought together more than 150 flagship brands, around thirty conferences, and dedicated space for young ventures. Our teams spoke with Moroccan and international franchise networks looking for a reliable register system to equip their points of sale.
